input.quote: This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: No non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant exists anywhere in the Agreement, so nothing restricts Corio (our party) from soliciting, hiring or engaging Commerce One personnel. Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "employ or engage" and "recruit" returned no results; the personnel provisions that do exist (§ 5 training, § 13.1-13.3 access to Commerce One operations/consulting/engineering personnel, § 13.5 Employee NDA/Invention Agreement warranty, § 14.5 independent contractors, Exhibit D § 5 Personnel) only govern the provision and assignment of staff and IP/confidentiality, and impose no hiring restriction on either party. Because this rule's preferred position is "No non-solicit on Customer," the absence of any such clause is compliant and no redline or comment is warranted. The cited entire-agreement clause (§ 14.10) is included only as the anchor showing the contract's full scope: it incorporates a separate Non-Disclosure Agreement and Statement of Work, so if either of those documents carries a non-solicit we would hold it to the fallback (mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire). Any deterministic checks for a 12-month term or general-solicitation carve-out are inapplicable here since there is no clause to qualify.
